description: UMCC is an OpenStreetMap-derived paired-image collection for urban morphology in 23 cities. The article and Zenodo record describe 11,711 tiles, each covering 768 by 768 metres. One image is a stylized ecological baseline with green and water areas and major roads or railways; the paired image classifies urban buildings, transport and open space. A JSONL index provides tile paths and coordinates, and a small code archive supports processing. Zenodo lists two public ZIP files under CC BY 4.0. WorldClim bioclimatic variables can be reconstructed with the supplied script but are not redistributed in the archive. Coverage is selected tiles in sampled cities, not a current citywide parcel register. The baseline is a constructed pre-urban template, not historical geography, and OSM completeness and styling are limitations for asset-level inference. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is comparing land-use layouts or testing urban-form scenario generation. model-osmnx is a related tool used in extracting source OSM features. No ZIP or code was downloaded, and OSM source licence conditions were not separately adjudicated.
